kind: drawing course page for absolute beginners
why: next in the smallest-first ranking of all sites (fewest interactive elements on the home page, ties to the lighter page): 99 nodes, 16.7 KB
rule: Verse assimilates the site: every feature it has, plus one notch, on one page wired into the rest of Verse.

features.theirs: a 'Drawing Fundamentals' course and a 'Begin the course' button (it links to #enrol and #, with no course behind it)
features.plus_one: the course itself, on the page: 8 drills in 4 units that start with one tap

features.theirs: line, shape, proportion and shading, named
features.plus_one: 2 drills in each unit, each scored from the strokes (distance from the line, roundness, how far off the middle, even steps of darkness)

features.theirs: 'Daily exercises: small drills that build real skill'
features.plus_one: a drill of the day, the same for everyone on a date, and a streak of days in a row

features.theirs: 'See like an artist: train observation, not just hands'
features.plus_one: a shape shown for 4 seconds then drawn from memory, the middle of a line judged by eye, a circle by eye at any size

features.theirs: 'Encouraging pace: progress you can actually see'
features.plus_one: first try and best try per drill, as scores and as the two drawings side by side, and how far up since the first try

features.theirs: 'Absolute beginners', 'no talent required, just a pencil and a few minutes a day'
features.plus_one: a finger, pen or mouse is the pencil; no account, no cookies, works offline

features.theirs: a cookie notice with Accept and Decline
features.plus_one: no cookies at all, so nothing to accept: scores stay in the browser's own storage
a drawing travels in its link and is scored again from its strokes when the link opens
